input: Find nature, outdoor adventure, farm, horseback riding and fishing summer camps and summer programs for kids and teens in or near Hendersonville, Flat Rock, Etowah, Horse Shoe, Laurel Park, Zirconia and Saluda, NC (Henderson County). Search the web thoroughly (several searches with different wording and town names) and list every organization you find.
searches: Hendersonville Flat Rock Horse Shoe summer camp horseback farm nature 2026
Henderson county 4-H 2026 summer fun camps nature

candidates.name: Bullington Gardens
candidates.note: Summer nature camp at the botanical gardens.

candidates.name: Ellaberry Llama Farm
candidates.note: 2026 day camp for ages 6–13 with llama care, hikes, creek activities and crafts.

candidates.name: Historic Johnson Farm
candidates.note: Summer 2026 guided forest-bathing programs admitted teens ages 16 and older; also offers farm day camps.

candidates.name: Blue Star Camps
candidates.note: Jewish overnight camp for ages 6–16; separate week-long horseback skills camps announced for 2027.

candidates.name: Camp Pinnacle
candidates.note: Two-week coed overnight sessions with kayaking, mountain biking and off-campus outdoor adventures.

candidates.name: Camp Tekoa
candidates.note: Day and overnight camps, including outdoor adventure and water-adventure programs for ages 9–17.

candidates.name: Kanuga
candidates.note: Runs Camp Kanuga and outreach summer camp Camp Bob; Camp Kanuga has announced 2027 sessions.

candidates.name: Camp Ton-A-Wandah
candidates.note: Girls’ overnight camp with lake activities, hiking, rafting, rock climbing and camping trips.

candidates.name: Camp Wayfarer
candidates.note: 2027 overnight sessions for rising kindergarten through grade 12, including teen adventure sessions.

candidates.name: Bonclarken Conference Center
candidates.note: Camp Bonclarken ran July 19–24, 2026, for boys and girls who completed grades 2–8.

candidates.name: Falling Creek Camp
candidates.note: Boys’ overnight camp with horseback riding, backpacking, paddling, farm activities and spin/fly fishing.

candidates.name: Camp Mondamin
candidates.note: Boys’ outdoor adventure overnight camp for ages 6–17; 2027 registration announced.

candidates.name: Camp Green Cove
candidates.note: Girls’ overnight outdoor adventure camp with horseback riding and wilderness trips; 2027 sessions announced.

candidates.name: Talisman Camps
candidates.note: Outdoor adventure camps for ages 6–22 with autism, ADHD or learning differences; includes children and teen programs.

candidates.name: Green River Preserve
candidates.note: Coed nature-focused overnight camp for grades 1–12; enrollment open for summer 2027.
